alt: Adrenal + gonadal steroidogenesis - cholesterol → pregnenolone (P450scc, rate-limiting). Diverges into mineralocorticoid (→ aldosterone), glucocorticoid (→ cortisol), and androgen (DHEA → testosterone/estradiol) pathways via cytochrome P450 enzymes.
